title: security: the 18 migration text says organization admins assign positions and permission sets to their members; the shipped organization_admin sets are read-only on both assignment objects and the server refuses
body:
Filing gate ①: a `finding`, class (b), a published declaration that the runtime contradicts. **reach:** measured once at a public entry (HTTP, below). It is also release text: the declaration ships in `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.2's `dist/migrations`, which builds the upgrade guide.

**Reader who acts:** objectstack triage, which routes this. The two halves live in `packages/spec/src/migrations/**` and `packages/plugins/plugin-security`. Which half is wrong is a product call: the anti-escalation rule against ADR-0131 D3's assignment promise. Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`). The source is objectui#12082 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12685): dev report objectstack-ai/objectui#12082 comment `6216723500` and the seat's browser check of that PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The two declarations (objectstack `origin/main` `11fea6b00`)
1. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.walled-catalog-tenant-writes-retired.ts`, its `replacement` text, line 26:

   > an organization's administrators assign it to their own members through `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set`, which are unchanged.

2. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/rbac-objects.test.ts:63`, the pin `organization_admin is read-only on global RBAC tables to prevent privilege escalation`: `organization_admin` has `allowRead: true` and `allowCreate`, `allowEdit` and `allowDelete` all `false` on `sys_user_permission_set` and `sys_user_position`.
   - `organization_admin_no_bypass` is derived from it (`deriveWallLessOrgAdmin`), so it is read-only on both as well.
   - The set carries `setup.access` and `manage_org_users`.
   - The pin does not depend on the tenancy posture.

## Measured
Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `pnpm exec objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, banner `Tenancy: single`. No commit between `66d456d01` and `570f01d27` touches `packages/plugins/plugin-security`, `packages/core/src/security` or `plugin-auth`. Every write below is the one the Setup console sends for Add / Remove.

| principal | how made | writes | answer |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| org admin, wall-less | `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/update-member-role {role: "admin"}` → 200; the auto-grant wrote `organization_admin_no_bypass` | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set`, `DELETE …/sys_user_permission_set/:id`, `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position`, `DELETE …/sys_user_position/:id` | each 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`: "[Security] Access denied: 'insert' on 'sys_user_permission_set' requires tenant-level administration or a delegated adminScope (ADR-0090 D12) — plain CRUD grants on RBAC tables do not make a permission administrator." (`delete` and `sys_user_position` the same) |
| holds `organization_admin` itself | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set {permission_set: "organization_admin"}` as the platform admin → 201 | the same four | each 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`: "You do not have permission to perform this action." (the object CRUD step) |
| platform admin (control) | seeded | the same four | 201, 200, 201, 200 |

`GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` for both org admins reads both assignment objects as read-only. So on this posture no organization administrator can do what the replacement text says they do.

**Not measured:** a walled (group or isolated) posture, the one the entry's `surface` names. The read-only pin applies there unchanged, but whether a walled org admin holds a delegated `adminScope` was not measured.

## Options, for triage (the seat's reading, not a ruling)
- **A — the text is wrong.** Correct the replacement text to name who does assign under a walled posture: the platform operator, or a holder of an ADR-0090 D12 `adminScope`. This is a release-text correction in `packages/spec/src/migrations/**`, and the upgrade guide regenerates.
- **B — the sets are wrong.** Give organization administrators create and delete on both assignment objects within their organization, through the delegated-administration path. That moves a privilege-escalation guard, so it is a security surface and the maintainer's call.

On the objectui side, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12685 makes Setup read the create / delete grant on each assignment object. The console follows either answer with no further change.

**Dedupe** (objectstack, open and closed): REST lists of every `domain:services` and `domain:spec` card, paged explicitly, 2755 rows, grepped:
- `walled-catalog-tenant-writes-retired`: 0;
- `read-only on global RBAC`: 0;
- `assign it to their own members`: 0;
- `organization_admin` near the assignment objects or "read-only": 5 hits, all other subjects (#22278, #14029, #13822, #11670, #10982);
- positive control `permission_set|permission set`: 146 hits.

Dedupe words: organization admin assign permission set, organization_admin read-only sys_user_permission_set, walled-catalog-tenant-writes-retired replacement text, upgrade guide org admin assignment.
